name: Force Game Event Command Blueprint
description: Blueprint defining the structure for the 'force_event' command.
author: NeoEngine v1

command.name: force_event
command.description: Triggers a specific game event (e.g., weather change, NPC quest, world boss spawn).

parameters.name: event_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the event to trigger.

parameters.name: target_region
parameters.description: Optional: The region where the event should occur. If omitted, applies globally.
